dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: *sigh* I haven't been out in the fields for a while now. I wonder how the harvest is going...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: You were just on my mind... You've been saying that our daughter is of marriageable age now, have you not?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Ah, we can't simply leave her with those layabout thugs, can we...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: But still, if she's got her eye on someone, we should advise her a little...

choices.text: I think you've got the wrong person...

response.speaker: Jiangcheng
response.text: What... I've got the wrong person?

response.speaker: Jiangcheng
response.text: Nonsense! Have my eyes ever deceived me in all the years we've been together?

response.speaker: Jiangcheng
response.text: And didn't you say, after all, that you would be my second pair of eyes even after I've gone blind?

response.speaker: Jiangcheng
response.text: Come now, there's no way I wouldn't recognize you. You're the only thing on my mind! Hahaha...

response.speaker: Jiangcheng
response.text: Ah, she's not a little girl any more. She's emerged as a beautiful young woman...

response.speaker: Jiangcheng
response.text: In fact, she looks just like... Hmm, what does our daughter look like? I can't seem to remember.

response.speaker: Jiangcheng
response.text: ...Oh, right, come to think of it, I've never seen her grown up.

response.speaker: Jiangcheng
response.text: If it was not so stormy that night... If I had come an hour earlier...

response.speaker: Jiangcheng
response.text: Then our daughter... and you, wife, we would be...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Ah, sure. Wife... don't forget to look after our land...
